title: fix(jsdom): fix `Request` with `Blob` body on jsdom 28+
body:
### Description

Under `environment: 'jsdom'`, a `Blob` used as a request body arrives as the string `undefined`. `makeCompatBlob` reads jsdom's private `_buffer` field, which jsdom 28 renamed to `_bytes`. Reads whichever exists so both halves of the `*` peer range keep working.

Adds a test that fails without the change: a `Blob` used as a `Request` body. The existing `supports Blob` test uses an empty blob and only checks `toBeInstanceOf`, so it never saw the content go missing.

The related Node 24 `File`/`FormData` breakage (#9135) is a separate issue with a different cause (undici 7 reading `File` from the global) and will be a follow-up PR.

Resolves #11294
